caption: The video captures a woman in a bright studio with a full-height mirror wall on the right and a white wall on the left. She stands back to the camera in a dark floral sleeveless top, white tiered skirt over shorts, socks, and sneakers. Her reflection faces the viewer and repeats the motion. Her hands are already bent near her head in the first visible frames. They rise and come together above her head, then open upward. The arms extend high and gradually spread outward and downward toward a wide horizontal span. Later they lower from that span toward the sides as the elbows bend and the hands move near her hips. Her feet stay apart with one heel lifted, and the camera and background remain fixed during this visible arm motion.
